name: stay-tuned
description: 留频 — 播客与电台调谐器。订阅 RSS 播客，播放 M3U 电台，PC / 移动双端界面。

scripts.android:sync: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.desktop:prepare: npm run build && npm run desktop:icons
scripts.desktop:dir: npm run desktop:prepare && STAY_TUNED_ADHOC_SIGN=1 electron-builder --dir --publish never
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run desktop:prepare && STAY_TUNED_ADHOC_SIGN=1 electron-builder --publish never
scripts.desktop:mac: npm run desktop:prepare && STAY_TUNED_ADHOC_SIGN=1 electron-builder --mac dmg zip --x64 --arm64 --universal --publish never
scripts.desktop:win: npm run desktop:prepare && STAY_TUNED_ADHOC_SIGN=1 electron-builder --win nsis portable --x64 --arm64 --publish never
scripts.desktop:linux: npm run desktop:prepare && STAY_TUNED_ADHOC_SIGN=1 electron-builder --linux AppImage deb rpm tar.gz --x64 --arm64 --publish never

author: HarryLoong (https://github.com/xzl01)
